name: Specter
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls that rely on sight.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken, until it finishes a Long Rest. The target dies if this attack reduces its Hit Point maximum to 0.

description: Specters are the hateful, formless remnants of the violently slain, haunting the place of their death and lashing out with a chilling, life-draining touch.
